name: Warp
summary: Agentic development environment built from the terminal, with a built-in coding agent or your own CLI agent; client source now on GitHub (AGPL-3.0).
description: Use Warp's built-in agent or run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other CLI agents inside it. The client codebase is open source in `warpdotdev/warp`: the UI framework crates (`warpui_core`, `warpui`) are MIT and the rest is AGPL v3; OpenAI is named as the founding sponsor of the open-source repository. The repo itself is developed with Warp Factories (cloud agents that triage issues, write specs, implement and review PRs; early access). Pricing (Oct 2026): Free; Build $20/month with $20 of agent usage at API rates; Max $200/month; Business $50/user/month.

agent_access.notes: Desktop app; AI features need a Warp account. Agent usage beyond plan credits is billed at API rates.
